heading: Terms & Conditions for Western Cars Adur
intro: These Terms and Conditions explain how bookings, fares and private hire taxi services are provided by Western Cars Adur. They apply to bookings made by telephone, online, through an app or through an authorised representative. By requesting or using a taxi, local journey or airport transfer in Shoreham-by-Sea, Lancing, Southwick, Portslade, Hove, Brighton, Worthing or the wider Adur and West Sussex area, you agree to these terms. For questions or to request a confirmed fare, call 01273 473737.

sections.title: 1. Who these terms apply to
sections.body: In these Terms and Conditions, 'we', 'us' and 'our' means Western Cars Adur; 'you' and 'your' means the person making or using a booking; 'driver' means the licensed private hire driver assigned to the journey; 'journey' means the agreed transport from the collection point to the destination; and 'booking' means a reservation accepted by us. Western Cars Adur provides 24/7 private hire taxi and airport transfer services from Shoreham-by-Sea across Adur, West Sussex and nearby areas, subject to vehicle and driver availability.

sections.title: 2. How taxi and airport transfer bookings are confirmed
sections.body: A booking request is not a confirmed booking until Western Cars Adur accepts it and confirms the journey details. You can request a taxi by telephone, online, through an app or via an authorised representative. We may decline a booking where no suitable vehicle or driver is available, where the journey details cannot be safely fulfilled, or where the request is otherwise unsuitable. Please provide accurate collection, destination, passenger, luggage, flight and contact details. Airport passengers should book enough time for check-in, security, traffic and other travel requirements.

sections.title: 3. Fares, estimates and fixed-price quotations
sections.body: A fare estimate is not the same as a confirmed fixed fare. Website, app or telephone estimates are based on the information supplied and may change if the route, distance, waiting time, stops, vehicle requirement or other journey detail changes. A fixed price applies only when Western Cars Adur has expressly confirmed it for the agreed journey details. Before accepting a booking, we will explain any known additional charges. If you need a guaranteed fare for an airport transfer or a longer journey from Adur, call 01273 473737 before booking.

sections.title: 4. Waiting time, diversions and additional charges
sections.body: For standard collections, the first 5 minutes of waiting time are free and further waiting is charged at 40p per minute. For airport arrivals, up to 60 minutes of waiting from the recorded landing time is free; flight delays do not create an additional waiting charge, but passengers should provide the correct flight number. Further waiting is charged at 40p per minute. Additional pick-ups, drop-offs or diversions may incur a minimum charge of £5. Airport parking, drop-off or collection fees, tolls, out-of-area mileage, luggage storage and other journey-related charges may also apply where they are relevant and disclosed.

sections.title: 5. Out-of-area collections and dead mileage
sections.body: Western Cars Adur serves Shoreham-by-Sea, Lancing, Southwick, Portslade, Hove, Brighton, Worthing, Goring-by-Sea, Littlehampton, Angmering, Arundel, Steyning, Henfield, Burgess Hill and the wider West Sussex and East Sussex area. For a collection outside our normal operating area, the fare may include dead mileage: the distance a vehicle travels without a passenger from the nearest suitable operating base to the collection address. We will explain this calculation and confirm the total before accepting the booking. No undisclosed dead-mileage charge will be added to a confirmed fixed-price booking.

sections.title: 6. Late-night, seasonal and special-event surcharges
sections.body: A midnight or late-night surcharge may apply to journeys during designated overnight periods. Additional charges may also apply during Christmas, New Year, public holidays, major events, festivals, concerts, sporting events, road closures or periods of exceptional demand. Any applicable surcharge will be explained with the revised fare or calculation before the booking is accepted. A surcharge that was not disclosed and agreed will not be added retrospectively to a confirmed fixed-price booking.

sections.title: 7. When a confirmed fare can change
sections.body: A confirmed fare remains binding for the agreed journey details. The fare may change if you request a different date, time, collection address, destination, vehicle, additional stop or other service; if waiting-time charges become applicable; or if the journey requirements materially change. We will communicate any revised fare and obtain your agreement before applying a requested change. If you do not accept a revised fare before acceptance, the booking will not be confirmed at that price.

sections.title: 8. Cancellations, no-shows and amendments
sections.body: Cancel or amend a booking by calling 01273 473737 as soon as possible. Standard bookings cancelled at least 1 hour before collection and pre-booked airport transfers cancelled at least 24 hours before collection will normally not incur a charge. A cancellation made with less notice, a no-show or a passenger who cannot be contacted may incur a cancellation charge up to the estimated fare or another charge communicated at booking. We allocate up to 1 hour for a standard collection and up to 3 hours for an airport collection before treating the booking as a no-show, subject to the journey details and reasonable attempts to contact you.

sections.title: 9. Passengers, children and assistance animals
sections.body: Passengers must follow the driver's reasonable safety instructions and behave respectfully. We may refuse or end a journey where a passenger is abusive, threatening, disorderly, intoxicated, carrying prohibited items or presents a safety risk. Assistance dogs, including guide dogs and hearing dogs, are welcome in accordance with the Equality Act 2010. Other animals may be carried at the driver's discretion if safely secured. Tell us when booking if you are travelling with children or need a child seat; child seats are subject to availability, and passengers should provide a suitable seat where required.

sections.title: 10. Vehicles, luggage and prohibited items
sections.body: Vehicle capacity depends on the vehicle type booked. A standard saloon or estate normally carries up to 4 passengers and their luggage, subject to safe space and weight limits. Tell us about large, fragile, unusual or excess luggage before booking; we may refuse luggage that makes the vehicle unsafe. We do not carry explosives, firearms, flammable or pressurised items, illegal drugs, hazardous waste, human remains, cash, securities, perishables, alcohol or other prohibited goods. We are not responsible for loss of or damage to luggage or personal property except where caused by our negligence. Check your belongings before leaving the vehicle and contact us promptly about lost property.

sections.title: 11. Delays, events outside our control and liability
sections.body: We will make reasonable efforts to provide a safe and timely journey, but cannot guarantee arrival times. We are not responsible for delay or failure caused by traffic, accidents, road closures, severe weather, flight disruption, vehicle breakdown, strikes, government restrictions, public events or another circumstance outside our reasonable control. Allow sufficient time for airports, railway stations and other connections and consider suitable travel insurance. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or any liability that cannot legally be excluded. Subject to those limits, our liability in connection with a journey is limited to the fare paid for that journey.

sections.title: 12. Privacy and personal information
sections.body: We use booking and contact information to arrange journeys, communicate with passengers, process payments where applicable, handle complaints, prevent fraud and meet legal obligations. We do not store card details unnecessarily or sell customer information. Information may be shared with drivers, service providers or fraud-prevention and credit-reference agencies where necessary and lawful. Please read our Privacy Policy for more information about how Western Cars Adur handles personal data.

sections.title: 13. Complaints and customer support
sections.body: If you have a question, complaint or comment about a taxi, driver, fare or airport transfer, contact Western Cars Adur on 01273 473737 or write to Basepoint - Shoreham, Little High Street, Shoreham-by-Sea, BN43 5EG. Please include the booking date, journey details and your contact information so we can investigate. We aim to acknowledge complaints promptly and resolve them within 14 days where reasonably possible. Driver licensing concerns may also be raised with the relevant local licensing authority.

sections.title: 14. Business and referral partnerships
sections.body: Hotel, venue, corporate, referral and other business partnerships may be subject to separate written arrangements with Western Cars Adur. Booking procedures, account terms, invoicing, commissions and referral responsibilities are not created by these customer Terms and Conditions. Partners must provide accurate information and must not represent Western Cars Adur as their employee, agent or exclusive transport provider unless agreed in writing.

sections.title: 15. General terms and governing law
sections.body: No waiver of a breach is a waiver of a later breach. If any provision is found invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions will continue to apply. These Terms and Conditions and any contract for a Western Cars Adur journey are governed by the laws of England and Wales, and disputes are subject to the courts of England and Wales.

sections.title: 16. Updates to these Terms and Conditions
sections.body: We may update these Terms and Conditions to reflect changes in law, services, fares, technology or operating procedures. The current version is published at westerncarsadur.co.uk/terms-and-conditions. The terms that apply to a confirmed booking are the terms published when that booking was accepted, unless a change is agreed with you or required by law. These terms were last updated in November 2026.
